review_improvement: Retains the exact source stimulus and in-band interface while making the target and MMHUB-specific blast radius/evidence explicit instead of accepting any amdgpu error line.
independent_technical_reasoning: MMHUB mediates GPU virtual-memory translations, so an uncorrectable event may surface as VM faults or broad client disruption rather than only a generic RAS count. The supplied UMC query checks another block and cannot prove a clean MMHUB state. Thus the implicit target must be mapped, block3-specific driver fields must align with the injection time and post-event mappings/clients must be healthy. A retry could compound address-space failures and is unsafe.
